snippet.title: Ancient Rome Live
snippet.description:
Welcome to Ancient Rome Live — your front-row seat to the ancient world.
Hosted by archaeologist and educator @DariusArya, ARL brings the Roman Empire to life through on-site lectures, live walks, and source-based deep dives. From Rome’s iconic landmarks to overlooked ruins, we explore the topography, history, and culture of one of the greatest civilizations in history.
🎥 Weekly videos include:
Mondays: original content of ancient monuments, sites throughout the Mediterranean, daily life, emperors
Wednesday: From the Vault live-recorded lectures
🔗 Looking for immersive travel + adventure? Check out @dariusarya on Tuesdays and Fridays
📚 Free educational resources + upcoming tours at AncientRomeLive.org
 
Ancient Rome Live is part of the American Institute for Roman Culture,  a U.S. 501(c)3 non-profit organization whose mission is to promote and defend Rome's cultural heritage through educational programs, projects, public outreach in archaeology, conservation, video, and social media.

snippet.title: The History Code
snippet.description:
Welcome to The History Code.

We crack the code on the hidden histories, unsolved mysteries, and dark truths that textbooks left out. From the real-life events that inspired your favorite Anime to the gritty underworld of the Yakuza, we bridge the gap between pop culture and the past.

If you love True Crime, Japanese History, or just want to know the disturbing reality behind the Samurai, this is the channel for you.

What to expect: 🕵️‍♂️ Dark History & Mysteries: The events they don't teach in school. 🇯🇵 Japan & Asia: From the 47 Ronin to modern Organized Crime. 🎬 Anime vs. Reality: The historical facts behind shows like Demon Slayer and One Piece. 📉 Shorts & Deep Dives: Quick facts for your morning routine and documentaries for your weekend.

Subscribe to decode the past. #history  #japan  #truecrimecommunity  #documentary  #animehistory

snippet.title: Arthur Revives the Past
snippet.description:
History isn't dead, it's just waiting to be told.

Welcome to Arthur Revives the Past, the place where history stops being about dry dates and starts becoming a living experience. My mission is to rescue the most fascinating events in human history and breathe life back into them.

I don't just tell you what happened; I show you. By combining deep historical research with cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence, I recreate faces, landscapes, and legendary moments with stunning realism.

On this channel, you will find:

Epic Tales: Immersive narratives about empires, heroes, and forgotten legends.

AI-Powered Recreations: Breathtaking visuals that transport you directly into the ancient world.

Mysteries of Antiquity: Deep dives into the events that shaped human civilization.

History isn't dead—it was just waiting for the right technology to wake up. Subscribe and join me as we bring the past back to life.

snippet.title: Bedtime History
snippet.description:
Bedtime History makes history simple, engaging, and easy to understand for all ages. Perfect for kids, families, and curious minds, each episode turns big ideas and important moments into clear, memorable stories.

Whether you’re listening at bedtime, in the car, or in the classroom, Bedtime History helps make learning feel simple, meaningful, and fun—one story at a time.

snippet.title: What If
snippet.description:
An epic exploration of possibilities. Join Peter and explore science-based hypothetical worlds across space, technology, Earth, and prehistoric history. Each episode begins with a simple “what if” question and follows real scientific theory, physics, biology, and astronomy to see where those ideas could lead.

Travel from deep space and alien planets to future technology and ancient life on Earth, and discover how small changes in science or history could reshape life, civilization, and the universe. It’s a blend of science education, imagination, and real research that helps you see our world, and the cosmos, from a fresh perspective.

snippet.title: History Rebuilds
snippet.description:
Welcome to History Rebuilds!
Step into the past like never before. Using cutting-edge AI, we bring lost eras back to life with stunning, immersive reconstructions of historical cities, daily life, and iconic moments—from the bustling streets of Victorian London in the 1800s to the grandeur of Ancient Rome, Paris in the Belle Époque, and beyond.
Watch as ruins transform into vibrant worlds: smooth fly-through tours, time-lapse evolutions spanning centuries, and narrated journeys through authentic historical details based on real sources.
New videos every week—perfect for history lovers, curiosity seekers, and anyone fascinated by "what it really looked like."
Subscribe and hit the bell 🔔 to never miss a revival of the past!
#HistoryRebuilds #HistoricalReconstructions #AIHistory #AncientRome #VictorianLondon #LostErasRevived

snippet.title: TED-Ed
snippet.description:
TED-Ed’s mission is to create lessons worth sharing. Feed and expand your curiosity with our award-winning animated shorts - published on YouTube and available with supplemental learning materials on ed.ted.com.

Want to suggest an idea for a TED-Ed animation, nominate an educator or animator? Visit our website at: http://ed.ted.com/get_involved.

Consider backing us on Patreon. By doing so, you directly support our nonprofit mission to create free, high-quality educational content: https://www.patreon.com/teded

For more information on using TED-Ed content for commercial purposes (e.g. employee learning, in a film, or in an online course), please submit a Media Request using this link: https://media-requests.ted.com/
